title: Extract public assistant text
responsibility: Extracts text parts from assistant events while ignoring other event content.

inputs.name: publicCliEvents.value
inputs.description: The candidate CLI event passed to the extractor. Only a truthy object whose type is "assistant", whose message is a truthy object, and whose message.content is an array can yield text; all other values return an empty list.
inputs.unknownReason: The extractor filters unvalidated CLI event objects by event and message fields.

outputs.name: publicCliEvents
outputs.description: The result contains text strings from content parts in their original order. Only parts with type "text" and a string text value are included; other parts and malformed events yield no entries.
